mentions.name: AWSight
mentions.description: Continuous AWS security posture monitoring service with compliance mapping to SOC 2, NIST, and CIS, offered at a flat rate starting at $249/mo for smaller organizations.
mentions.problem: SMBs are stuck between paying enterprise prices for tools like Security Hub + Config rules (which can hit $2-5K/mo on a mid-size account) or flying blind, with little in between for teams that need to pass audits without a dedicated security person.
mentions.audience: Engineering teams at smaller orgs that need to pass audits but don't have a dedicated security person.
